title: Vestibule doors.
officialText: Where access to the stairway is by way of a vestibule, the door assembly into the vestibule shall be a fire door complying with Section 715.4. The door assembly from the vestibule to the stairway shall have not less than a 90-minute fire protection rating complying with Section 715.4.
